```{julia}
event_log = load_log(run_path)

```

```{julia}
log_last = unique(sort(event_log, [:bee1_id, :time], rev = [false, true]),
                :bee1_id)

select!(log_last, Not(:bee2_id, :task_id))

task_cols = names(log_last, r"^task_")

#task_cols = filter(
    #c -> startswith(c, "task_") && c != "task_id",
    #names(log_last)
#)

log_long = stack(
    log_last,
    task_cols,
    variable_name = :task,
    value_name = :acc
)
```

```{julia}
best_per_task = combine(groupby(log_long, :task)) do sdf
    sdf[argmax(sdf.acc), [:bee1_id, :acc]]
end
```

```{julia}
axpos = (1,1)
labelsize = 22
ticklabelsize = 20
acc_evofig = Makie.Figure(size = (800, 600))
ax = Makie.Axis(acc_evofig[axpos[1], axpos[2]], 
        xlabel = L"\text{Simulation Time}", 
        ylabel = L"\text{Accuracy}",
        #title = "Evolution of Accuracy of the best performing agent per task",
        xlabelsize = labelsize,
        ylabelsize = labelsize,
        xticklabelsize = ticklabelsize,
        yticklabelsize = ticklabelsize,
        )
ax.xticks = Makie.LinearTicks(7)
for task_row in eachrow(best_per_task)
    bee_id = task_row.bee1_id
    task_id = task_row.task
    bee_log = filter(row -> row.bee1_id == bee_id, event_log)
    Makie.lines!(bee_log.time, bee_log[!, Symbol(task_id)])
end
```
